Tracking & data quality notes

  • Conversion tracking: one overview panel displays “Tag inactive”; another metrics strip shows 5 conversions. The screenshots therefore need conversion tracking validation before treating the conversion figure as confirmed.
  • Invalid activity: 8 invalid clicks (1.82% invalid click rate) and 334 invalid interactions (1.71% invalid interaction rate) are visible in the supplied metric panels.
  • Viewability: 79,102 measurable impressions, 53,582 viewable impressions and 25,520 non-viewable impressions are shown.
  • Metric variation: some panels show 8,592 views while campaign/metric tables show 8,593. This report retains 8,593 from the campaign table and preserves the original screenshots below for reference.
